data.name: Cinnaboi Baked Brawl
data.detailed_description:
Launch

As the world of Cinnaboi expands, new characters, new attires, and new content will be added for free. This is a game meant to grow, evolve, and give players something memorable to return to—whether you’re here for the story, the combat, or the quirky universe of food warriors finding their place in the world.


About the Game

Cinnaboi is a flavorful 2D side‑scrolling fighter where a cinnamon bun with a legendary lineage battle through chaotic kitchens, dangerous diners, and fridge‑dwelling foes. Play solo, jump into PvP, or team up with friends in local co‑op and online multiplayer as you rise through the ranks of the fiercest food fighters alive.

Cinnaboi comes from a long bloodline of powerful culinary warriors, and he’s joined by an expanding roster of edible icons. Fight as Cinnaboi, Cindy, Francois, The Marinara Mafia, Donut Dave, and many more characters—each with unique movesets, flavorful abilities, and over‑the‑top finishing attacks.

Story Mode follows Cinnaboi’s journey of self‑discovery, blending animated cutscenes with intense battles that test your skills and your survival. Every environment—from bustling restaurants to cluttered kitchens to the mysterious depths of the fridge—is fully interactable, packed with hazards, secrets, and opportunities for creative combat.

The world of Cinnaboi is brought to life with a diverse soundtrack spanning multiple musical genres, giving each stage, character, and moment its own distinct energy and personality.

FEATURES

  • 2D PvP & Single‑Player Action — Fight through story missions or challenge friends and rivals.

  • Local Co‑Op & Online Multiplayer — Team up or throw down across multiple modes.

  • A Growing Roster of Food Warriors — Each with distinct abilities, combos, and finishers.

  • Interactive Environments — Use kitchen tools, restaurant chaos, and fridge hazards to your advantage.

  • Animated Story Sequences — Discover Cinnaboi’s origins and the legacy of the food‑warrior bloodline.

  • Fast‑Paced, Flavor‑Packed Combat — Designed for both casual fun and competitive depth.

  • Genre‑Spanning Soundtrack — A diverse mix of musical styles that enhances every fight and environment.

esrb.descriptors:
Cinnaboi is a mature 2D side‑scrolling fighter set in a world where food warriors clash in intense, stylized combat. Battles feature heavy hits, dramatic finishers, and exaggerated impacts that push the action into darker, more intense territory. Characters can be knocked apart, crushed, sliced, or slammed with high‑energy effects, creating a violent but stylized tone that earns its Mature rating.

The story explores deeper themes of legacy, betrayal, fractured families, and the harsh realities of surviving in a world built on conflict. Animated cutscenes include moments of tension, emotional weight, and mature character interactions as Cinnaboi uncovers the truth behind his bloodline and the power struggles shaping the culinary underworld.

Players will encounter:

Stylized violence with intense, high‑impact attacks

Darker humor and sharp character banter

Mature themes involving rivalry, revenge, and personal identity

Perilous environments where hazards can brutally end a fight

Villains and factions with morally gray motives and aggressive behavior

While the world is vibrant and exaggerated, the tone leans heavier, the stakes are higher, and the conflicts cut deeper. This is a food‑fighter universe where every battle has consequences, and every character carries scars—physical or emotional—from the wars they’ve survived.

Cinnaboi delivers a mature, stylized brawler experience filled with intense combat, dramatic storytelling, and a gritty culinary world where only the strongest rise to the top.
esrb.interactive_elements:
Users Interact — Players can engage in online PvP, co‑op, matchmaking, lobbies, and player‑to‑player communication.

In‑Game Purchases — Optional cosmetic items may be available; all gameplay content updates remain free.

Shares Location — Online features may use approximate regional data for matchmaking and server selection.

Unrestricted Internet — Online multiplayer and community features connect to external servers and player‑hosted sessions.

Online Multiplayer — Battle or team up with others through online matchmaking and private lobbies.

Local Co‑Op & PvP — Multiple players can play together or against each other on the same device.

Player‑to‑Player Interactions — Includes competitive combat, cooperative play, and lobby interactions.

Shared Online Play — Players may encounter others in public or private online spaces.

User Progression — Characters, unlocks, and cosmetic items are earned through gameplay.

Interactive Environments — Stages contain hazards, objects, and elements that react dynamically to player actions.
